table:columns.name: geometry

table:columns.name: URLtext

table:columns.name: MS_CD

table:columns.name: AdjacentHydrometricArea
table:columns.description: Hydrometric area adjacent to the coastal water body.

table:columns.name: LOCALAUTHORITY
table:columns.description: Local authority or authorities the water body lies in.

table:columns.name: AreaHectare
table:columns.description: Area of the water body in hectares as computed by the EPA.

table:columns.name: AreaKm2

table:columns.name: Easting
table:columns.description: Easting of a representative point in the Irish Grid (EPSG:29902), in metres.

table:columns.name: Northing

table:columns.name: bbox
